title: Create Capitalism S 1
body:
### Info:
This is a Modpack for my server. And before you ask No you can't join it. **But** it might become open! Some day... what am I saying, it will like in 3 to 10 years if it's still alive that is.

### Short Description:
Explore the world of create and its dozens of add-ons.
This includes some small ones like create jetpacks and some bigger ones like create garnished.

### Long Description:
1. Create! duh...
2. a LOT of decor stuff.
3. New tools and weapons!
4. Tetra aka Customizable equipment!
5. A handful of new biomes to expand in.
6. Changed up the audio physics, ambience sounds and visual effects!
7. A lot ‘a nice multiplayer features.
8. A couple of quality of life mods.
9. No major mob griefing! :D
10. A player driven economy!
11. You know the dirill Literaly, All resorces are ∞! [I think]

---
### Try Hosting

Why not try hosting yourself! After all Essentials is right there. And this is how, this modpack got here. I just got an idea and did it!
